findings.reason: pyproject.toml builds with hatchling.build and has no [project.optional-dependencies]. The dev extra is declared only in setup.py extras_require (lines 25-33), which hatchling ignores, so '.[dev]' installs the runtime deps only and the tests in tests/ can't run. I kept this at medium rather than X1's high: it breaks the dev workflow, not runtime behaviour.
